answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and files a paired receipt per job: an ember receipt proving fresh work, plus a jade seal from a verifier's re-run. A half claim sits at its nadir, worth zero; mismatch or reuse burns the bond. Each pair costs 40, +6 per extra pair per source: 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. A rented-pair ring cannot fake both halves. An honest agent files one pair, pays 40 once, reclaims the bond.
